PLAN: Mash kills Grimmsnarl; pivot Aero->Spiritomb for burn when Ape targets Meta slot; Incineroar in only after Ape dead (or late Fake Out); Tailwind turn 2+ vs backline speed.

reflections.summary: Won because the preview plan was right and executed cleanly: Aerodactyl + Mega Metagross lead dismantled the opponent's repeated Grimmsnarl/Annihilape opening — Taunt denied the second screen and Annihilape's Protect while super-effective STABs (Meteor Mash, Zen Headbutt) scored back-to-back OHKOs and a +1 Attack boost, creating a 4v2 the opponent's Primarina/Talonflame could never recover. reflections.adjustment: When Incineroar enters against Talonflame, lead with Fake Out instead of attacking — the flinch denies Will-O-Wisp/Tailwind that turn and keeps Metagross unburned at full damage.
